details: The drag handler (line 366–387) calls sankey.update(graph) and updates all link path attributes on every mousemove with no requestAnimationFrame or dirty-flag coalescing, causing an update storm during node dragging. All other interaction patterns are sound: pointer events unify mouse/touch, there are no cross-view dispatches to create feedback loops, no D3 transitions are used during drag so there are no mid-flight conflicts, and scales are not captured in stale closures.
